title: Audit Log — truthful job merge event
acceptance_oracle: When a new company-feed posting with a distinct provider identity is attached by the existing exact same-company application-route rule to a different canonical job, append one profile-scoped JOB_MERGED event in the same transaction. The safe Activity timeline shows the fixed summary, job title and company after reload, and another profile cannot see it. A replay of the same posting, an ambiguous/unmerged route, or a rolled-back import must not create the event.

implementation.event_producer: Company-feed ingestion records JOB_MERGED only after persist_posting accepts a previously unseen posting whose selected canonical job differs from the provider-native proposed job ID.
implementation.transaction_and_idempotency: Posting attachment and profile audit event share the ingestion transaction. The event ID is deterministic per profile and posting; failed transaction writes roll back together. Profiles are recorded only when their evaluated version is still current.
implementation.history_privacy: The stored payload contains only the canonical job ID. The API returns a fixed summary and allowlisted job title/company context; source posting payload, application URL and posting ID are omitted.
implementation.replay_behavior: Existing posting refreshes are excluded. A distinct application route that remains a separate canonical job is excluded.
implementation.remaining_scope: This implements only the JOB_MERGED event producer/readback slice. MJ-REQ-176 remains PARTIAL/OPEN while other event producers and complete truthful application lifecycle coverage remain to be evidenced. External employer receipt or submission is not inferred.
